decisions.reason: As a recently launched printer close to the core marking portfolio, it still has option value in a growing firm and industry, and its strategic fit is strong enough that management would likely wait for more market evidence before abandoning it.

As a software add-on built directly on the existing offer, it is inexpensive to keep available and complements the firm's digitalization and traceability direction, so real-options logic favors keeping it open.

Because it extends the established inkjet range to non-absorbent surfaces that matter for packaging and industrial customers, and because it is still early after launch, management would likely retain it while uncertainty resolves further.
